main_body: desert building with flat roof parapet, dome, and brick front wall
top_band: light sandy beige roof surface with inner parapet shadows and turquoise dome (rows 3 to 33)
evidence: The structure clearly shows both a horizontal flat roof plane (rows 3-33) bounded by a parapet wall and hosting a dome, a highlighted front cornice edge at row 32, a dark eave shadow beneath the cornice at rows 34-36, and the vertical brick front wall (rows 34-63) with an inset door and window.

style.evidence: While the candidate uses tinted material outlines and has multi-step ramps on the dome and bricks, the brickwork is large, repetitive, and geometrically rigid compared to the richly varied, densely shaded stone and roof tiles of the Beodeul reference buildings. The roof gravel and dome base also have large stretches of simple or uniform pixels.
